title: lowerAttribute swaps the resource/span attribute carrier columns
notes:
lowerAttribute (internal/traceql/lower.go) resolves a scoped attribute reference to its carrier column; this patch swaps the two branches so `resource.<key>` reads SpanAttributes and `span.<key>` reads ResourceAttributes. Both detectors target TraceQLScopeCollisionAttributeKey (`environment`, #3444/#3518's gen/traceql.go), the same key stamped into BOTH maps per span with disjoint value pools so a scope mix-up cannot coincidentally pass.

The HTTP detector runs the traceql.selector.scope-collision-conjunction shape from the property roster (`{ resource.environment = X && span.environment = Y }`) through property.CompareTraceIdentityOutcomes, the TraceID-multiset comparator this repo's TRACEQL-PROPERTY-EVIDENCE-TRACE-IDENTITY contract documents — reused as-is, not reimplemented.

The gRPC detector (internal/api/tempo/grpc) is a genuine equal-cardinality, wrong-identity case, not a count difference: it seeds two traces whose resource/span environment values are exact MIRRORS of each other (trace1: resource=prod/span=shadow; trace2: resource=shadow/span=prod), so the swapped query matches exactly one trace either way — just the WRONG one (trace2 instead of trace1) under the mutation. A bare match-count assertion is blind to this; the detector asserts the exact matched TraceID instead, which is what catches the misattribution.

Both detectors were hand-verified to fail (kill) against this exact patch — the HTTP shape roster reports two missing traces (empty result where two were expected); the gRPC case reports the wrong TraceID — and to pass cleanly against the unmutated tree.

Limits: TraceQLScopeCollisionResourceValuePool / TraceQLScopeCollisionSpanValuePool are each only 2 values wide, and no live reference-Tempo differential (compatibility/tempo/driver) carries an equivalent same-key resource/span collision case today. See issue #3528 for a related, separately-filed contracts.json documentation gap this same generator strengthening exposed.
